subject.title: feat(ui): redesign cron page as sidebar-first Automations master-detail

question: Should upgrades preserve every valid persisted sidebar selection, or migrate the exact prior default `["overview"]` to include Automations?
rationale: The stored value cannot distinguish an untouched old default from an intentional identical customization, so implementation logic cannot safely choose the upgrade contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve persisted pins
options.body: Apply the new Automations pin only to fresh or invalid settings and leave every valid saved selection unchanged.

options.title: Migrate exact old default
options.body: Rewrite `["overview"]` to include Automations, accepting that intentionally overview-only users will also change.

options.title: Keep existing default
options.body: Do not pin Automations by default and limit the PR to the page redesign and naming change.

recommendation.title: Preserve persisted pins
recommendation.body: Apply the new Automations pin only to fresh or invalid settings and leave every valid saved selection unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the paired product proposal and current implementation and has recent history on the affected navigation surface.
